title: Fix the blank-screen crash when a candidate adds a new row under the Family sect
description:
[The user currently has the "Candidate Onboarding Record" screen open (object emponb_candidate_record, type T). Resolve "this", "this form/page/screen", or "here" to this object unless they name a different one.]

When "Candidate Self" page link is sent to the user via mail from "Candidate Onboarding Record" page and user tries to add new record under "Family" section 
then the pages crashes and shows blank screen because of this user is unable to add new family member details. Check this issue and fix it.

todos.label: Fix Relation field in the Family detail form so adding a new family row no longer crashes the candidate self-service page
